acceptedAnswer.text: It is generally performed with gentle, rhythmic movements rather than deep pressure. Tell your provider if anything feels uncomfortable.

mainEntity.name: Is manual lymphatic drainage the same as deep tissue massage?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The techniques differ in pressure and purpose. Deep tissue massage uses more focused muscle work; MLD uses light movement in a specific sequence.

It should not be marketed as a proven general detoxification treatment. Your liver, kidneys and other organs handle normal waste processing; MLD has more specific clinical uses related to fluid management.
Ask your surgeon or treating healthcare professional first. Timing and suitability depend on the procedure, current healing and medical guidance.

mainEntity.name: What if my swelling has no clear cause?

acceptedAnswer.text: New, persistent or unexplained swelling should be medically evaluated before booking a massage.

mainEntity.name: How often do people need MLD?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no universal schedule. Any treatment frequency for medical swelling should follow an individualized healthcare plan.
